report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy: order checkout trace OK at 64ms, error_rate 0.0014, p95 76ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, and INFO/200 logs across gateway, order, and payment. The order deploy (3.1.1, 497 min old, valid config) cannot by itself establish latency. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, so hand off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated error rate or latency) to confirm the alert is real
Per-service error/latency breakdown isolating which service degrades checkout
Dependency timeout or db_pool_waiter data during the degraded window
Logs/traces capturing failing requests rather than only successful ones
